label: third original token (t=2) is r/t/y/g
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at step t=2 (96% of activation mass; t=3 has about 4%), when the third original token is one of a small set of letters: r (strongest, about 37% of mass), t, y, then g, with weaker tails on s, j and e. Never fires at t=0/1, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (under 0.2% of mass). Magnitude goes r > t > y > g and also depends on the first two tokens (top examples start with z, e.g. z z r, z 0 r). About 24% of t=2 r/t/y/g steps stay below threshold, and the earlier-token context that explains this was not captured.
